Just days after releasing its powerful open source, general purpose Mistral 3 LLM family for edge devices and local hardware, the company returned today to debut Devstral 2. The release includes a new pair of models optimized for software engineering tasks — again, with one small enough to run on a single laptop, offline and privately — alongside Mistral Vibe, a command-line interface (CLI) agent designed to allow developers to call the models up directly within their terminal environments.
